# Cases not yet passing against juice 12, with the reason.
# Format: <variant>/<fixture>  <reason>, or */<fixture> for every variant.
#
# This list is self-ratcheting: a skipped fixture that starts passing FAILS the
# build until its line is removed, and a line naming a fixture that no longer
# exists fails too. It can only shrink. `wc -l` is the progress metric.
#
# An ALLOW entry is a divergence we have decided to keep. Those are described
# in the README and should stay rare.
*/inline-seed/quotes  ALLOW: juice throws a CssSyntaxError on style="font-family:&quot;A B&quot;" because it feeds the undecoded attribute to postcss. Crashing on ordinary email is not worth matching.
inline-pseudo-elements/cascade/pseudo-element-no-leak  inlinePseudoElements is not implemented yet
inline-pseudo-elements/pseudo-elements/dropped-by-default  inlinePseudoElements is not implemented yet
inline-pseudo-elements/pseudo-elements/single-colon  inlinePseudoElements is not implemented yet
inline-pseudo-elements/serialization/style-in-string  inlinePseudoElements is not implemented yet

*/premailer-suite/misc/commented_out_styles_in_the_body  ALLOW: juice reads "<!-- p" as a selector and applies nothing; CSS ignores <!-- and --> in a stylesheet, so browsers and premailer apply the rule, and so do we.


# css-inline's test suite (testdata/in/css-inline-suite)

*/l4-spec/empty-whitespace  :empty treats whitespace-only text as empty
*/l4-spec/ignored-pseudo-argument  ignored pseudo-classes inside arguments are not detected, so the rule is inlined
*/l4-spec/is-complex-inside  an :is() alternative with combinators is spliced in as text, changing which element it constrains
*/l4-spec/is-in-not  :is() inside :not() is not expanded, so the rule is dropped
*/l4-spec/not-never-matching  :not() of a selector that never matches drops the rule
*/l4-spec/pseudo-element-argument  a pseudo-element inside :is() is matched rather than rejecting the rule
*/l4-spec/universal-type  "*a" is rejected rather than read as "a"
*/malformed/semicolon-after-rule  a semicolon after a preserved rule's closing brace is dropped
*/malformed/stray-semicolon-at-rule  a stray semicolon before an at-rule swallows the at-rule into a selector
*/nesting/comments  CSS nesting is not flattened
